$comment: The planned line-up of the Cookbook: the design catalogue's recipes (number, wave, chapter, order, level, title and what each will cover, with registry ids). `pnpm cookbook coverage` lists what no recipe covers and which planned recipe would; `pnpm cookbook new <planned-slug>` takes its chapter, Nº and order from here. Planning data only: a recipe's own recipe.json is the truth once its folder exists. Wave 6 (Nº 074–086) holds the Chinese recipes of issue #201, each row as its recipe.json has it. Wave 8 (Nº 105–114) holds the Arabic recipes: Modern Standard Arabic (Nº 105–109, issue #384) and Classical Arabic (Nº 110–114, issue #385). Rows 110–114 carry the feature ids their recipes teach (arabic-verse, kashida among them).
